links.comparator_used: EagleEye AI alone, and the original pathologist sign-out (P1) without AI
links.outcome: Detection of CIN2+ (vs <CIN2) on cervical biopsies, including additional case-finding and correction of AI errors by pathologist adjudication
links.effect: EagleEye alone vs P1: sensitivity 93.3%, specificity 71.8%, kappa 0.67. With the AI-assisted consensus (EE + P2) as the comparator, P1 had 83.8% sensitivity and 100% specificity, so the workflow found additional CIN2+ cases signed out as <CIN2 by P1. EagleEye alone under-called ACIS but improved after adjudication. Several CIN3 cases flagged as SCC by EagleEye were confirmed by EE + P2 review.
links.quote: When the AI-assisted consensus (EE + P2) was used as an augmented internal comparator, P1 showed 83.8% sensitivity and 100% specificity, indicating that the human-in-the-loop workflow identified additional CIN2+ cases that had been signed out as <CIN2 by P1, particularly near the CIN1/CIN2 boundary.
